data.creator_notes:
So… I may have made a mistake and let [discord](https://discord.gg/lukeypoo) choose my special for hitting 100 followers, and the popular request was to make a self bot, but female. Am I going to regret it? Probably, but here we are. It’s hard to call Zyra a perfect copy of me, but hopefully some of my personality comes through when you chat with her. 

I had a tough time coming up with good greeting ideas for her, so if you have any, let me know.

Tonight though, back to my regularly scheduled fantasy bots and drama bots. I’m currently cooking a best friend turned tormentor which should drop tonight or tomorrow morning.

1) you bump into Zyra while she’s walking her dog before work
